name: System monitor
description: Show CPU, memory, disk, and the busiest processes of this Mac in one view, next to the project's other runs. Reads local system counters only; no sudo, no network.

actions.title: System monitor
actions.description: Sample CPU, memory, disk, and processes every few seconds and replace the System and Processes views. Runs until you stop it.

bar_width.description: Width of each bar, in characters.

top.description: Number of processes in the Top processes section.

sections.description: Sections of the System view, in this order.

actions.title: System snapshot
actions.description: Take one sample, save it in the Last snapshot view, and return the numbers as the result. Use it to read the numbers without a running monitor.

bar_width.description: Width of each bar, in characters.

top.description: Number of processes in the Top processes section and the result.

sections.description: Sections of the System view, in this order.
